summary: Build ISO/IEC 27002 control knowledge with PECB Foundation training, practical examples, and preparation for the one-hour exam.
audienceIntro: ISO/IEC 27002 Foundation is designed for people who need a grounded introduction to information security controls and their place in information security management.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certificate Holder in ISO/IEC 27002 Foundation credential, you must pass the PECB ISO/IEC 27002 Foundation exam and sign the PECB Code of Ethics; professional experience, management-system audit or assessment experience, and information security management system project experience are listed as none.
